added.title: Sr. Product Manager I - Regulatory Reporting
added.description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of our Regulatory Reporting products. You'll sit at the intersection of regulation, investment data, and technology, translating complex and changing regulatory requirements into scalable, client-ready product capabilities. You'll work closely with engineering and data teams and engage directly with internal teams and external clients to make sure our solutions meet their compliance obligations.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for regulatory reporting, balancing regulatory deadlines, client needs, and long-term platform goals.
Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the product, translating new and amended requirements into clear user stories, specifications, and acceptance criteria.
Partner with engineering on technical design, trade-offs, and delivery, taking part in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and architecture discussions.
Work with clients, compliance teams, and client-facing groups to gather requirements, run feedback sessions, and support onboarding and adoption.
Define how data flows across the investment lifecycle (trading, post-trade, operations, accounting, and reporting) and make sure regulatory outputs are accurate, complete, and auditable.
Shape the client-facing tooling experience, including data delivery, integrations, APIs, file formats, and reporting interfaces.
Define success metrics and track adoption, data quality, timeliness, and client satisfaction.
Collaborate across Engineering, Data, Compliance, Client Services, Sales, and Operations to deliver cohesive solutions.
Prepare product documentation, release communications, and client-facing materials.

Requirements

7+ years of product management experience, with a strong technical product perspective.
Background in regulatory reporting within financial services or fintech.
Working knowledge of the investment lifecycle, including trading, operational functions, and the reporting that flows from them.
Track record of working day to day with engineering teams in an agile environment.
Experience working directly with external clients, including gathering requirements and managing expectations.
Understanding of development architecture, workflows, and external client tooling (data feeds, APIs, integrations, reporting platforms).
Ability to break down ambituous, complex requirements into clear, actionable product plans.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

Familiarity with the regulatory regimes relevant to the business, such as:
MiFID II, EMIR
Solvency II (EIOPA/NCAs, e.g., BaFin (Germany), ACPR (France), IVASS (Italy), DNB (Netherlands), Central Bank of Ireland, CAA (Luxembourg))
Solvency UK (PRA)
BSCR (BMA, Bermuda)
Swiss Solvency Test (FINMA)
NAIC RBC (US states)
LICAT/MCT (OSFI, Canada)
ESG regulation (e.g., SFDR, EU Taxonomy, CSRD)
Experience with data modeling, data quality frameworks, reporting, or analytics tooling.
Experience with SaaS or platform products serving institutional investors, insurers, asset managers, or corporates.
Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, SQL, and BI platforms.

Salary Range

$156,400.00 - $210,841.00

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, benefits include: health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), PTO, parental leave, and medical leave, STD/LTD insurance benefits. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

added.description:
Vice President of Payments Product

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished Vice President of Payments Product to lead the strategy, development, and growth of the company’s payments product portfolio. This executive will define product direction, identify market opportunities, and build scalable payment solutions that support customer needs and long-term business objectives.

The VP will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams across Technology, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Sales, and Client Services to deliver secure, efficient, and scalable payment products.

The ideal candidate will bring 15+ years of product management and industry experience, including significant leadership responsibility across payments, financial technology, transaction processing, or related areas. The candidate should have a strong record of developing payment products, leading product organizations, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Payments Product Strategy

Define and execute the company’s payments product strategy and roadmap.

Identify customer needs, market opportunities, and emerging payment trends.

Evaluate new payment capabilities, business models, and product opportunities.

Align product priorities with corporate strategy and commercial objectives.

Product Development & Management

Lead the full product lifecycle from strategy and discovery through launch and optimization.

Establish product requirements, priorities, roadmaps, and success metrics.

Partner with Engineering and Technology to deliver scalable payment capabilities.

Continuously improve products based on customer feedback, performance data, and market developments.

Payments Infrastructure & Operations

Develop scalable payment workflows, transaction capabilities, and supporting infrastructure.

Partner with Operations and Technology to improve payment reliability, efficiency, and scalability.

Identify opportunities to automate processes and improve transaction performance.

Establish product standards that support growing transaction volumes and evolving customer requirements.

Risk, Compliance & Security

Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Security teams throughout the product lifecycle.

Ensure payment products incorporate appropriate controls and operational safeguards.

Evaluate product risks and develop mitigation strategies.

Support compliance requirements across relevant payment markets and operating environments.

Commercial & Customer Growth

Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Client Services to support product adoption and growth.

Develop product positioning, pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategies.

Identify opportunities to expand payment capabilities across customer segments.

Use customer and market insights to improve product value and commercial performance.

Product Organization Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing payments product organization.

Establish product management processes, objectives, and performance standards.

Recruit, develop, and retain senior product leaders and professionals.

Foster a culture of customer focus, innovation, accountability, and execution.

Product Performance & Analytics

Establish KPIs covering product adoption, transaction volume, revenue, customer retention, and operational performance.

Use data and business intelligence to guide product decisions.

Monitor product economics and identify opportunities for improvement.

Provide executive leadership with regular product performance and market insights.

15+ years of experience in product management, payments, fintech, financial services, or related industries.

Proven track record developing and scaling payment products and transaction capabilities.

Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, transaction processing, payment infrastructure, and customer workflows.

Experience leading products across strategy, development, launch, commercialization, and optimization.

Strong understanding of risk, compliance, security, and operational considerations within payments.

Demonstrated ability to translate customer needs and market trends into successful product strategies.

Strong analytical, strategic, financial, communication, and decision-making capabilities.

Experience working closely with executive leadership, engineering, operations, sales, and commercial teams.

Experience operating in international or multi-market payment environments is preferred.

Executive-level opportunity to shape the company’s payments product strategy and capabilities.

Opportunity to build scalable payment products within a growing financial technology organization.

Direct influence over product strategy, customer experience, and commercial growth.

Close collaboration with senior leaders across Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Commercial teams.

Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing payments product organization.

Internationally oriented environment focused on technology-enabled financial infrastructure.

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Airspace Monitoring Service
added.description:
Sr. Product Manager, Airspace Monitoring Service

Hidden Level is building the future of airspace awareness. Our mission is to make the unseen visible by providing persistent, actionable awareness of the low-altitude airspace around critical infrastructure, borders, military installations, airports, major events, and communities.

Our technology brings together multiple sensing modalities and airspace data sources to detect and track cooperative and non-cooperative aircraft and UAS. Through our Airspace Monitoring Service (AMS), we transform that data into an operational picture that can be consumed directly through Hidden Level applications or integrated into the command-and-control systems our customers already use.

Position Overview

As we expand, we are seeking a Sr. Product Manager, Airspace Monitoring Service (AMS) to own and advance the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for one of Hidden Level's core offerings.

This role sits at the intersection of our customers, engineering teams, operations, and business. The Sr. Product Manager will develop a deep understanding of customer missions and workflows, translate those needs into scalable product capabilities, prioritize what we build and why, and work closely with cross-functional teams to bring those capabilities to market.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable talking with an operator about how they use airspace data, working with engineers to define requirements and tradeoffs, analyzing product usage and performance, and communicating product strategy to company leadership.

Location:

This position may be based onsite or in a hybrid capacity at our Syracuse, NY office. Remote work may also be considered based on candidate location and business needs.

Responsibilities

Own the AMS Product Strategy and Roadmap
Develop and maintain the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AMS based on customer needs, market opportunities, company strategy, and technical capabilities.
Define the problems we are solving, desired customer outcomes, and measures of success before determining specific product solutions.
Prioritize product investments based on customer value, mission impact, technical feasibility, business value, and strategic differentiation.
Maintain alignment between near-term customer commitments and the longer-term development of a scalable product.
Represent the Customer and the Mission
Develop a deep understanding of how defense, homeland security, public safety, and commercial customers use airspace awareness to support operational decisions.
Spend time with customers and end users observing workflows, gathering feedback, and identifying unmet needs.
Translate customer and operational requirements into clear product requirements and use cases for engineering teams.
Distinguish between individual customer requests and capabilities that should become part of the broader AMS product.
Drive Product Development
Partner closely with Engineering Operations, Service, Deployment, Growth, and Customer Success throughout the product lifecycle.
Define requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and desired outcomes for new capabilities.
Make informed product tradeoffs when customer needs, technical constraints, schedule, and business priorities compete.
Identify dependencies, risks, and decisions required to keep product development moving.
Ensure teams understand not only what is being built, but why it matters to the customer.
Measure Product Performance and Adoption
Establish and monitor product metrics related to usage, adoption, performance, reliability, and customer outcomes.
Use operational data, customer feedback, and product analytics to identify opportunities for improvement.
Develop feedback loops between deployed systems, customers, and product development.
Evaluate whether delivered capabilities are solving the intended customer problem and adjust the roadmap accordingly.
Support Product Introduction and Growth
Partner with Sales and Customer Success to clearly communicate AMS capabilities, limitations, differentiation, and roadmap.
Support customer demonstrations, pilots, proposals, RFIs/RFPs, and strategic engagements where product expertise is required.
Help establish clear success criteria for pilots and deployments and translate successful customer outcomes into repeatable product offerings.
Support product releases, customer-facing documentation, training, and internal enablement.
Monitor competitive offerings, emerging technologies, regulations, and changes in the UAS and airspace-awareness market.
Interoperability and Ecosystem
Help define how AMS integrates with customer C2 systems, third-party sensors, APIs, and other elements of the broader airspace-awareness ecosystem.
Work with technical teams and customers to ensure interoperability is considered as a core product requirement rather than an afterthought.
Identify opportunities for partnerships and integrations that increase the operational value of AMS.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Product Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of relevant professional experience, including 3+ years in product management, technical product management, or a closely related role.
Demonstrated experience owning or materially contributing to the strategy and roadmap of a complex technical product.
Ability to translate customer problems and operational workflows into clear product requirements and priorities.
Experience working closely with software and/or hardware engineering teams.
Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to use data and customer feedback to make product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, operators, customers, and executives.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity, making tradeoffs, and taking ownership of outcomes.
Willingness to travel approximately 10–20% to support customers, deployments, exercises, and other product activities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, defense technology, public safety technology, or other mission-critical products.
Experience with geospatial applications, command-and-control systems, sensor data, APIs, data fusion, or real-time operational software.
Familiarity with radar, RF sensing, Remote ID, ADS-B, UAS, counter-UAS, or airspace-management technologies.
Experience working with Department of Defense, Department of Homeland Security, federal, state, or local government customers.
Experience taking complex technical capabilities from early deployment through broader product adoption and scale.
Experience with Agile software development and modern product-management practices.

Compensation and Benefits: Hidden Level offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, paid parental leave, flexible time off, 401(k) with employer contributions, life insurance, disability insurance, and potential stock options.

Salary Range: The salary range for this position is estimated at $134,000 to $174,000 annually. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Hidden Level considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Hidden Level is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Security Note: Due to the nature of Hidden Level’s technology, only U.S. citizens can be considered for this position. Hidden Level Employees must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance, if required for the position. Please click here to review the National Security Clearance Adjudicative Guidelines.

added.title: Director of Growth Product & Monetization
added.description:
Department:
Growth

Employment Type:
Permanent - Full Time

Location:
Remote USA - In Tandem

Compensation:
$160,000 - $180,000 / year

Description

At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life's biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.

We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.

If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

OurFamilyWizard serves hundreds of thousands of families navigating separation, divorce, and shared custody — and the way families find us is unlike most consumer products. Some arrive on their own. Others come through a trusted attorney, therapist, or mediator. Some are directed here by a court. Each path carries different intent, trust, and urgency, and turning that distinctive multi-channel model into lasting customer value is the core of this opportunity.

As Director of Growth Product & Monetization
, you'll own OurFamilyWizard's growth strategy end-to-end — reporting to the Chief Product Officer and working in close partnership with Marketing on acquisition, lifecycle, and brand. Success means moving the metrics that matter — conversion rate, renewal, ARPU, and revenue — and what makes those outcomes genuinely exciting is how directly they map to mission: more families converting means more families getting the support they need. And with success here, there's real opportunity to shape growth and monetization across the broader In Tandem portfolio.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real organizational reach. You'll align Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Data around shared priorities and stay close enough to the work to turn strategy into experiments and results. You'll use AI as a real execution lever, moving faster on research, modeling, and experimentation than a traditional growth function could.

What You Will Accomplish

Growth Strategy & Execution: Set OurFamilyWizard's conversion and monetization priorities and drive execution across direct-to-consumer, professionally referred, and court-directed journeys—recognizing that each audience enters with different intent and needs.
Growth Operating System: Establish shared metrics, a high-velocity experiment portfolio, and a regular growth review that helps teams learn quickly, make tradeoffs, and act on results.
Product & Marketing Alignment: Connect acquisition strategy and CAC with activation, conversion, engagement, and retention so OurFamilyWizard invests in customers it can serve well over time.
Pricing & Monetization: Lead pricing, packaging, and new-product monetization across app stores and web. Evaluate tier value, upgrade paths, and price changes using customer insight, unit economics, and OurFamilyWizard’s responsibility to families.
Professional Referral Growth: Deepen engagement and referrals across attorneys, mediators, therapists, custody evaluators, and courts. Improve the path from recommendation or mandate to sustained customer value, and partner on pro product strategy to advise on price/value and monetization of new products.
Scalable Growth Foundations: Partner with Data, AI, Marketing, and Engineering to strengthen experimentation, instrumentation, segmentation, and lifecycle capabilities. Build a repeatable approach to international expansion and an agile conversion funnel tech stack—with foundations designed to scale across brands.

Who You Are

A mission-connected operator who connects growth to real-world impact and cares about what happens to the families using OurFamilyWizard.
A hands-on strategist who loves being close to the work—establishing playbooks, building learning foundations, and turning strategy into experiments and results.
Skilled at reading consumer psychology and translating context-specific conditions into strong hypotheses that reduce friction and move parents to the right next action.
A collaborative leader who aligns cross-functional teams around shared priorities without relying on formal authority—and communicates up with the clarity to drive executive alignment.
High-velocity in experimentation: you form hypotheses, set priorities, understand statistical tradeoffs, and know when evidence is sufficient to act.
AI-native: you use current tools to improve the speed and quality of research, modeling, prototyping, and experimentation—while remaining accountable for the output.

What You Bring

7–10+ years building and leading consumer growth or monetization strategies with accountability for measurable outcomes across the full funnel.
Hands-on ownership of subscription pricing or packaging—including a price change, repackaging, or new-product monetization decision—and clear lessons from what didn't go as planned.
Strong business judgment with fluency in CAC, LTV, retention, payback, ARPU, and cohort performance; excellent data fluency and statistical analysis.
Excellent communication and influence skills that help you drive various perspectives and opinions towards a concrete and visionary strategy while keeping teams aligned around you to maximize impact and outcomes.
Hands-on PM experience and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering from managers to ICs; technical fluency that enables seamless engineering partnership.
Fluency in App Store, Google Play, and web subscription mechanics.
Experience with B2B2C growth, professional referral networks, international expansion, or high-trust products is a strong plus.
Understanding of the current limits and near-term potential of AI optimization and personalization.

Why Join?

We're redefining family technology.

In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families—and the professionals who guide them—through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.

Scale meets startup energy.

With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we're entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.

Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.

Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.

How We Support You

Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
Paid leave for all new parents
Learning & Development stipend for employees
Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays + Winter Break (3 Days) + Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) + Floating Holiday (1 Day)
Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0–1 years of employment + 20 days for 1–3 years of employment
Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!

Come As You Are!

added.title: Senior Product Manager, New York
added.description:
Fifth Dimension is the most prominent AI company in real estate in the world, bringing the magic of AI automation to document-heavy industries 🌈. Our AI workspace helps leading investment managers, owners, and operators across the US, UK, and APAC automate complex workflows, extract insights from critical documents, and make faster, smarter decisions.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, based in New York (preferred) or London, reporting to our Co-Founder & CPO, Johnny, and working alongside our other senior PM as a peer. This is a senior individual-contributor role: you'll own product end-to-end for a critical area, partner shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, and get as close to customers as anyone in the company. There's no team to inherit or build, your impact comes from what you ship and the standards you hold.

You're a builder who still ships. You can open Figma, write a brief, prototype in AI tools, cut scope, and make the call, and you back every decision with a commercial instinct for what actually drives adoption and revenue. We ship daily. You will too.

About Us

We're a London, New York, and Singapore based startup with ample runway, backed by Tier 1 European and American investors. We've raised $22m at Series A and are growing 6x ARR year on year. Our founders, Johnny Morris and Dr. Kate Jarvis, bring a powerful blend of expertise (and spice 🌶️): Johnny has 17+ years applying data and analytics to Real Estate, while Kate holds a Stanford PhD and 12 years of executive experience across Silicon Valley and London startups.

At Fifth Dimension, we're demanding yet encouraging, valuing experimentation and kind challenges. Our company values, Own It, Ship It, and Don't Be Boring
, drive us to deliver exceptional results while fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

What This Role Is

A senior IC who owns product end-to-end for a critical area, from customer insight through to shipped, polished product.
A builder who ships personally: Figma, briefs, prototypes in AI tools, scope calls, and the judgement to make them.
Turns product vision and live customer feedback into sharp, shipped product.
Carrier of product standards across engineering, customer success, sales, and customers.
Commercially wired — measures success in adoption and revenue, not features shipped.
Brings just enough process to keep things consistent (reliable, repeatable communication).

What This Role Is Not

A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat, there's no team to inherit or build, and no plans to add one for this role.
A process-only person. We don't want OKRs, PRDs, or roadmap theatre.
Someone who hasn't touched a product in 12 months.
Someone who needs the structure of a big company around them to be effective.

The Challenge

We're leaving real value uncaptured because the product hasn't yet been run with a sharp, customer-obsessed hand on every detail. What should the product look like to immediately communicate intelligence and connectivity? How do the first 30 seconds of a demo show we're an intelligence platform, not a chatbot? Where does the product win deals today, and where does it quietly lose them?

The problems here are genuinely novel. How do you present AI-extracted insights alongside source documents so a professional trusts them enough to make a $100M investment decision? How do you reason about agentic systems, evaluations, and probabilistic output, and still ship something customers rely on every day? How do you take something bespoke and turn it into something repeatable that ships?

Imagine it's Month 1. You've diagnosed, delivered, and productified a major customer deliverable — taken something bespoke and made it repeatable. You're in customer sessions forming strong opinions on where the product is failing them, and pushing engineering on it. You know where the product wins demos and where it loses them. That's the pace.

What You'll Do

Own and ship a product area. You own the product layer for your area end-to-end, customer insight through to pixel-level delivery, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering. We ship daily; you will too.
Turn vision and feedback into product. Take product direction and live customer feedback and convert it into sharp, shipped product, cutting scope, making the call, and holding the bar.
Get close to customers. Spend real time with enterprise customers, including the high-stakes conversations (renewals, a broken workflow, a promise made and kept). Bring what you learn straight back into the product.
Drive adoption and revenue. Sharpen how the product demos and sells so it visibly drives adoption and revenue, not just feature count. You'll see your decisions in the numbers.
Invent AI-native product. Agentic workflows, streaming outputs, document intelligence, confidence signals, human-AI collaboration. There's no playbook, you'll help write it, and use AI tools to collapse the gap between idea and shipped.
Keep the signal flowing. Bring light, reliable process, the consistent weekly updates and shared context that keep founders, engineering, and customers aligned without slowing anyone down.

About You

You're a senior product person who never stopped building. You've shipped product to real customers and you shipped something yourself in the last 12 months, you can open Figma, write a brief, prototype in AI tools, cut scope, and make the call. You're commercially wired: you think about adoption and revenue, not just what made it into the release.

You're genuinely AI-native. You've shipped AI product that customers use, you have opinions about agentic systems, and you can reason about evaluations and probabilistic output. That shows up in your own craft too, you work in AI-native tooling, you'll ship a small code change to unblock yourself, and AI has genuinely changed how you work. "I use ChatGPT and Figma sometimes" isn't what we mean.

You've been in the high-stakes customer conversations, a renewal on the line, a product that broke, a promise you had to make and keep, and you can talk through exactly how you handled them. You thrive in startup pace: high ownership, comfortable with ambiguity, curious, and an active communicator. You bring just enough process to be consistent, because you know that's where founders often need the most help.

What We're Looking For

Shipped AI product that real customers use, with real opinions on agentic systems, evaluations, and probabilistic output. (Must-have.)
Deep personal AI craft, AI-native in your own workflow (e.g. Claude and AI-native tooling, shipping small code changes yourself), not AI as a novelty. (Must-have.)
A commercial mindset, you measure yourself on adoption and revenue, and you understand how enterprise buyers evaluate, adopt, and expand. (Must-have.)
Still a builder, shipped product personally in the last 12 months: opens Figma, writes briefs, prototypes, cuts scope, makes the call.
Battle-tested in high-stakes customer conversations, renewals, a broken product, promises made and kept, and able to walk through them in detail.
Thrives in startup pace, high ownership, comfortable with ambiguity, curious, an active communicator, and brings just enough process to stay consistent.

Nice to Have

Domain knowledge in a specialist professional field, real estate, finance, legal, insurance, healthcare, or construction. Not required, but we expect you to do the research.
Experience with complex data products, extraction, search, intelligence, analytics, not pure SaaS CRUD.
Platform instinct, thinks in systems, APIs, skills, and compounding, not just features.
Can touch code, enough to prototype or unblock yourself.

Your First Few Months

Month 1.
You've diagnosed, delivered, and productified a major customer deliverable, turned something bespoke into something repeatable that ships. You're in customer sessions forming strong opinions on where the product is failing them and pushing engineering on it. You understand the product: where it wins demos and where it loses them.

Month 3.
Deep customer wins from the product being closer to customers than it's ever been, at least one account where the breakthrough came from you. The first measurable improvements to how we demo and sell are live, and you're on top of the metrics that matter: latency, trust, accuracy, adoption.

Month 6.
The product is the reason we're winning deals we wouldn't have won six months ago. Multiple deep customer wins where the compound effect is visible, better data, better workflows, higher adoption, expansion revenue, and product-led growth that's real and measurable, not a narrative.

Compensation And Benefits

We're hybrid three days a week in our New York (preferred) or London office.

$180,000–$250,000 base, plus meaningful equity. Flexible based on experience and seniority
Meaningful equity on a standard vesting schedule 📈
401(k) plan (US) or enhanced pension contributions (UK)
Generous paid time off
Health, dental, and life insurance (US) or private healthcare via BUPA (UK)
Enhanced parental leave: 14 weeks for the primary caregiver, 6 weeks for the secondary caregiver
Tailored support for exceptional challenges, different for everyone
2-week all-company December shutdown

added.title: Senior Product Manager II (TodayTix)
added.description:
About TodayTix Group:

TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix , New York Theatre Guide , London Theatre , Show-Score , Arthouse , Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema ––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment.

Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world.

In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI , the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement.

Life at TodayTix Group

We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next.

New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development.

Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work.

We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager II to join the TodayTix product team and raise the bar for how we build. TodayTix is TTG's flagship consumer product, it is the mobile app and web experience connecting millions of people with live events they love. Your work will directly shape how customers discover, purchase, and return to TodayTix, and will move the metrics that matter most to the business.

This is an outcome ownership role, not a project execution role. The team is in an acceleration phase sharpening prioritization, deepening analytical rigor, and shifting from shipping projects to owning results. You'll be central to that shift: someone who can pick up any problem space, build conviction quickly from ambiguity, and own it end-to-end, while modeling the product craft that lifts the whole team.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment, reach instinctively for AI to think and prototype, and are passionate about turning open-ended problems into measurable bets, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note: This is a full-time position. Qualified candidates must be based in the greater New York City area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, with flexibility to choose where you work for the rest of the week.

What Success Looks Like:

Strategy from ambiguity → Within 60–90 days, you've developed a strong understanding of your first problem space, diagnosed the gaps and contributed to a roadmap grounded in customer evidence and business priorities
Decisions driven by customer insight → A continuous discovery loop is running where one didn't exist; your understanding of our customers visibly changes what gets prioritized.
Team acceleration → Your ability to triage opportunities, gather the appropriate stakeholders and build relationships combined with your product intuition accelerates our overall tech team velocity
AI-native execution → AI is embedded throughout your workflow helping you synthesize research, generate prototypes, validate assumptions, and accelerate delivery.
Measurable impact shipped → Initiatives launch with defined success metrics and are followed by real post-launch analysis including second and third-order "why" questions that drive the next iteration.
Raising the team bar → Product thinking across the team is visibly sharper because of how you frame problems, document decisions, and give feedback.

What You'll Do:

Take full end-to-end accountability for specific TodayTix consumer product areas and their respective KPIs
Use AI tools to create prototypes, synthesize research, and communicate product ideas clearly and efficiently.
Collaborate closely with engineering, design and partner teams to deliver consumer features that solve real customer problems.
Lead by example to champion high-quality product standards and analytical rigor, utilizing your own work and constructive feedback to elevate the collective thinking of the team.
Manage complex cross-functional initiatives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned.
Operate across the product lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and validating concepts to delivering and iterating on solutions.

We're Looking for Someone With:

An entrepreneurial spirit who is energized by the opportunity and challenges of shaping how millions of people across the world discover, purchase and experience live entertainment
6+ years of product experience, including 2 - 3 years owning consumer products end-to-end in startup / growth environments with demonstrable impact
Incredible product intuition, natural curiosity, a strong bias for action, an ability to form strong opinions with limited information and influence peers
Fluency with AI tools as part of your daily workflow - using them habitually to accelerate research, optimize process, design, prototype, drive decisions, and execution.
Demonstrated builder mindset - whether through launching products, founding something, side projects, experimentation, or creating new processes from scratch.
Demonstrated growth mindset - committed to continuous professional and personal development
Strong communication and strategic thinking in cross functional environments
Experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing and adjacent consumer technology platforms
Experience in live events, hospitality, marketplace, or premium consumer experiences is a plus.

$190,000 - $210,000 a year

Salary ranges are determined by competitive market data for our size, stage, and industry, experience and location of the applicant, and our internal salary banding, which is reviewed at least annually.

We aim to be as transparent, equitable, and fair as possible. Qualified candidates and our Talent Acquisition team will discuss salary and benefits in the initial conversation, and final salary will be determined after candidates complete the interview process. We expect that the majority of candidates who are offered roles at TTG fall healthily throughout the range based on the above factors.

To learn about the Perks and Benefits outside of the salary, please check out our "Good to Know" section!

added.description:
About Radar

Radar is the global leader in geolocation, with geofencing SDKs, maps APIs, and AI-enabled solutions for marketing, fraud, and operations teams.

Why is Radar the best place to work?

We're trusted by some of the world's best companies, from high-growth startups to the Fortune 500.
We have incredible scale: We're processing over 1 billion API calls per day from hundreds of millions of devices.
We're well-resourced, and we've raised $85.5M from world-class investors, including Accel and Insight Partners.
We have a high-performance culture, with ambitious and entrepreneurial teammates in every role.
We recently moved into an amazing new office in Flatiron, Manhattan, NYC.
We were recently named a top 10 best place to work in NYC by Crain's.

Despite our growth and scale, we're still just getting started. That's where you come in.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Product Manager to own product strategy and execution for Radar Maps Platform. This role is based in our NYC HQ.

For years, teams have had to stitch together expensive, fragmented, and legacy mapping providers. Many start with Google Maps or Mapbox, then run into cost, flexibility, reliability, or platform limitations as they scale. Radar Maps Platform is changing that.

Radar Maps Platform has geocoding, autocomplete, address validation, search, routing, map tiles, static maps, dynamic maps, and UI components in one developer-friendly platform. But Radar is more than a maps provider. We also offer a full-stack geofencing platform, giving customers maps, geocoding, routing, location tracking, geofencing, trip tracking, places, fraud detection, and location intelligence in one integrated platform.

That combination is unique. Customers can replace legacy maps vendors, reduce cost and complexity, and build richer location-based experiences on top of the same infrastructure already powering their geofencing, tracking, marketing, operations, and fraud use cases. Hundreds of companies have switched to Radar Maps Platform in the last few years.

What You'll Do

Own the product strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer outcomes for one of Radar's fastest-growing products, Radar Maps Platform
Work closely with customers and prospects to understand how they use maps today, why they are switching from legacy providers, and what they need to build better location-based experiences
Lead a full-stack product team of engineers and designers shipping across backend systems, frontend experiences, web and mobile SDKs, APIs, UI components, map rendering, dashboard workflows, playgrounds, usage tracking, documentation, and developer tools
Use data analysis to understand where Radar Maps Platform has gaps in coverage, accuracy, freshness, latency, or cost, then work with Engineering and external data providers to close those gaps
Write crisp product specs, 1-pagers, documentation, and launch plans
Use AI to move faster: creating designs, prototypes, analyses, documentation, and even code changes where useful
Run sprint planning, QA product experiences, keep projects on track, and help the team ship high-quality work quickly

Bonus Points If You

Have worked on maps, geocoding, routing, search, logistics, delivery, mobility, developer platforms, APIs, SDKs, data infrastructure, or location-based products
Have worked with address data, POI data, map tiles, road network data, imagery, or other geospatial datasets
Are a former founder or have operated with founder-level ownership

The Hiring Process

After a call with our Technical Recruiter, you'll do several Zoom calls with members of our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams. If those go well, we'll invite you to our NYC HQ for a final round interview. You'll meet one of our co-founders, someone from outside EPD, and more people from around the company.

You'll Work With

Nick Patrick, Co-Founder and CEO
Tim Julien, CTO
The Radar Maps Platform Engineering team
Our customers and prospects
Our Marketing, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Sales teams

What We Offer

Competitive salary
Meaningful stock options in a fast-growing company
401(k) plan with 4% match
New HQ in Flatiron, NYC
Top-notch equipment
Catered lunches
Unlimited PTO
Health, dental, and vision insurance with 100% coverage for employees
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Commuter and fitness benefits

We’ll share full details of our benefits package at the offer stage. Benefits may vary by location.

Radar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
